description: This file contains classes and methods for normalizing arguments and operators within the PyTorch FX framework, specifically for transforming and standardizing function calls and operator usage in computational graphs.

classes.name: NormalizeArgs
classes.description: A Transformer subclass that normalizes function arguments to match module signatures, converting args/kwargs to kwargs if specified, and populating default values.

classes.name: NormalizeOperators
classes.description: A class that normalizes different operator call sites to a canonical form, mapping operator functions to their torch equivalents.

methods.name: run_node
methods.description: Processes a Node to normalize its arguments and handle type disambiguation.

methods.name: call_function
methods.description: Normalizes a function call, potentially remapping it to a different function based on schemas.

methods.name: call_module
methods.description: Normalizes a module call with argument rewriting.
